CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
